class.name: FileSystemDatabase
class.brief_description: A [NetwDatabaseBackend] that keeps records in files under one directory.
class.description: Records stay on disk after the game closes. Use it for a singleplayer or listen server game. [codeblock] var backend := FileSystemDatabase.new() backend.root = "user://saves" Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(backend) [/codeblock] Each slot is a directory under [member root], and each record is one file inside it. A file this library did not write fails to read with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED].

method.name: _delete_slot
method.description: Removes the directory for [param slot] and every record inside it. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK slot was absent or was removed ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN slot could not be opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION the process cannot remove the slot ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_WRITE removing the slot failed [/codeblock]

method.name: _list_slots
method.description: Reads [member root] and resolves every slot directory it contains. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK root was read and slots were listed ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN root could not be opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION the process cannot read root ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_READ reading root failed [/codeblock]

method.name: _open
method.description: Opens [param slot] and resolves a [NetwDatabaseConnection] for its directory. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK slot was opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN the slot could not be opened ┠╴ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION the process cannot open the slot ┖╴ERR_FILE_CANT_READ reading the slot failed [/codeblock]

members.member: The directory every slot lives under. Use a path under [code]user://[/code], which an exported game can write to on every platform.
